# CuiSharp

> CuiSharp binds CUI, a C99 immediate-mode UI library, to C#. It draws native
> windows with no XAML, no WPF, no Avalonia and no web view. Rebuild the whole UI
> every frame from your own fields; there is no control tree, no binding and
> nothing to invalidate.

## Rules

- `Draw(Ui ui)` runs every frame, synchronously. Never `await`, `.Result`, `.Wait()` or `Thread.Sleep` in it.
- `Ui` and every scope are `ref struct`: no fields, no capture, no `await`. State lives in your own fields.
- Scopes are `using` blocks; interactive widgets take `ref` and return `bool`.
- Text fields take `ref string`; CUI edits the value and returns it on the frames it changed.
- A widget id is a stable string. Inside a loop, wrap each row in `using (ui.Id(item.Id))`, or enumerate `ui.Keyed(items, key)`.
- Long work goes through `Mutation`: create it once, call `Run()` from a button, read `IsRunning` and `Error`.
- A page that changes on its own needs `WantsFrames => true`, or the window sleeps.
- Per-frame code allocates nothing: no LINQ, no `new`, no string concatenation. Interpolate into a widget instead.
- Find a control in a frame by a query: a label (`Save`), a kind and a label (`Button "Save"`), or a path (`Card "editor" > Save`).

## Entry points

- `CuiApp.Run(options, ui => ...)` — one window, one callback per frame.
- `CuiApplication.CreateBuilder(args)` + `Run<TRoot>()` — hosted app with DI and `Component` pages.
- `CuiSurface.Create(w, h)` + `surface.Draw(render, pixels)` — headless frame for tests and benchmarks.

## Testing and tools

- `TestApp.Start(component, w, h)` — drive a real component with no window: `FindButton("Save").Click()`, `FindInput("draft")` + `Type("Milk")`, `Frame(n)`, `Focus()`, `Key(key)`, `Faults`, `PaintedAnything()`, `SavePng(path)`.
- `app.Tree` / `app.Print()` — the frame as the app drew it, nesting included; `SemanticNode.Find(query)`, `Descendants()`, `Path`.
- `HeadlessApp` — the same driver in the framework, which `TestApp` names; `dotnet cui` drives it in a real process.
- A tab strip and a segmented control record one control per item (`Tab "Markets"`, `Segment "Dark"`), so an item is found and clicked like any other control.
- `surface.LastFrame` -> `FrameSample` — what the last frame that surface drew cost: `DrawMs`, `AllocatedBytes`, `FrameMs`, `Fps`, `IsLive`. `FrameStats` holds the same for the one window in the process, which is what a footer reads.
- `dotnet cui tree|find|click|type|key|focus|move|frame|faults|png` — one command per line; `dotnet cui session` relays a whole script against one build; `--app` for a published build, `--no-build`, `--frames N`. Any app opts in by running headless (`CUISHARP_HEADLESS=1` or `--headless`).

## Core API (hand-written, in `src/CuiSharp/Ui`)

- `ui.Input(UiText id, ref string value, InputOpts o = default)` -> `InputResult` — single-line text field.
- `ui.TextArea(...)`, `ui.Search(...)` — the same shape, multi-line and search affordances.
- `ui.Number(UiText id, ref double value, double min, double max, NumberOpts o = default)` -> `bool`.
- `ui.LineChart(UiText id, ReadOnlySpan<float> values, ChartOpts o = default, Color color = default)` — one series, draws nothing when empty.
- `ui.BarChart(...)` — the same for bars; `ui.LineChart(id, Series[] series, ...)` for several series.
- `ui.DonutChart(UiText id, float[] values, string[]? labels = null, ChartOpts o = default)`.
- `ui.Canvas(UiText id, Size width, Size height, PaintFn paint)` — custom drawing: `paint(ui, box)` with `ui.DrawLine`, `DrawRect`, `DrawCircle`, `DrawText`, `DrawPath`.
- `ui.Id(int)`, `ui.Id(UiText)` -> `IDisposable` — a scope that prefixes every id inside it; `ui.Keyed(items, key)` enumerates with ids.
- `ui.Shortcut(Mods mods, Key key)` -> `bool`, `ui.WantsKeyboard` — keyboard input, unmodified when a text field has focus.
- `ui.RequestRedraw()`, `ui.NeedsRedraw` — rarely needed directly: the host does this from `WantsFrames` and pending work.
- `ui.RequestWakeup(float seconds)` — one more frame this many seconds from now: a timer, a toast timeout, a poll interval.
- `ui.LastId` -> `uint` — the id of the widget just drawn; what `TourStep.Target` and the other point-at-this APIs take.
- `ui.Terminal(UiText id, Terminal terminal, TerminalOpts o = default)` -> `TerminalResult` — the `Terminal` class owns the scrollback (`Write`, `WriteLine`, `Clear`, `LineCount`).
- `ui.LogView(UiText id, LogBuffer log, LogViewOpts o = default)` — `LogBuffer` owns the ring (`Append`, `AppendLine`, `Text`, `Clear`), the view adds level filters, search, follow and copy.
- `ui.MeasureText(text, size, font)` -> `TextMetrics`; `ui.Time`, `ui.DeltaTime`, `ui.FrameCount`, `ui.DpiScale`; `ui.MousePosition`, `ui.MouseDown`, `ui.MouseClicked`, `ui.KeyDown`, `ui.KeyPressed`, `ui.Modifiers`, `ui.WantsMouse`; `ui.RectOf(id)`; `ui.IsDisabled` and `using (ui.Disabled(flag)) { ... }`.
- `ui.DrawRect`, `DrawRectGradient`, `DrawShadow`, `DrawLine`, `DrawPolyline`, `DrawPolygon`, `DrawCircle`, `DrawArc`, `DrawText`, `DrawIcon`, `DrawImage`, `using (ui.Clip(rect))` — the primitives a custom control paints with.
- `ui.HexView(id, Span<byte>, ref HexSelection, HexViewOpts)` — the editable hex view; the span is pinned, so a typed byte lands in your array.
- `ui.TreeTable(id, columns, TreeNode[], row, [ref TableSort, ref int], TreeTableOpts, label)` -> `TreeTableEvents` — a tree over a flat node array the table rewrites; `events.Load` names the nodes whose children it wants, and `CuiTree.Sort(nodes, root, compare)` relinks siblings.
- `ui.State<T>(id)` and `ui.State(id, onFree)` -> `Span<T>` — per-id scratch that survives frames; the second form adds a callback CUI runs when it evicts that id (release a texture, a lease, a pooled buffer).
- `ui.DiffRows(id, Span<DiffRow>, first)` — the live diff view's rows, for a custom renderer.
- `Color.Oklch(l, c, hue, alpha)`, `Color.Mix(a, b, t)`, `color.WithAlpha(f)`, `ui.ColorOf(color)`, `ui.TokenColor(token)`, `Ui.AccentName(accent)`, `Ui.KeyName(key)`.
- `CuiMath.DiffLines(old, new)` / `DiffWords(old, new)` / `EvaluateCurve(keys, x)` / `EvaluateGradient(stops, t)` / `PathMatches(path, filter)`; `MarkdownText.ToggleTask(ref text, offset, result)`; `CuiFiles.ListDirectory(path)`; `CuiSurface` input: `MouseMove`, `MouseDown`, `MouseUp`, `Click`, `Scroll`, `KeyDown`, `KeyUp`, `Type`, `Focus`, `FileDrop`.
- `ui.Theme` and `ui.Accent`: assign `Theme.Dark` or `Accent.Blue` from inside any frame and CUI animates the change; `ui.ToggleTheme()` is the dark-mode command.
- `ui.Style` -> `ThemeStyle`, the design tokens: `var t = ui.Style;` then `t.RadiusControl`, `t.RadiusPanel`, `t.RadiusSurface`, `t.ControlSm`/`ControlMd`/`ControlLg`, `t.TextXs`/`TextSm`/`TextBody`/`TextLg`, `t.FontScale`, `t.Motion`, `t.GetHeading(level)`/`t.SetHeading(level, points)` for heading levels 1-4. The local is a pointer into CUI's own theme, so nothing is copied and nothing allocates, and an assignment applies from the next frame. A theme or accent switch keeps the radii, the motion multiplier and the font scale.
- `ui.Style[token]` is the palette, `t.ToneInfo`/`ToneTeal`/`ToneViolet`/`ToneRose` are the four tone colours a widget reads live (the rest are tokens), and `t.GetShadow(elevation, layer)`/`SetShadow(...)` are the two layers each elevation is drawn with. Padding and gap are not tokens: a container carries its own in its `Box`.
- `ui.SetLocalization(table)` and `ui.Localization`: the month, weekday and "Today" names the date components show. A `Localization` object holds the names (each nullable, falling back to English), owns the unmanaged table CUI reads every frame, and the surface keeps it alive; null restores English.

## API

- `ui.AgentPlan(UiText id, ReadOnlySpan<PlanStep> steps, AgentPlanOpts o = default)` → `int` — Agent plan: steps with their status on a connected rail, and progress.  ([AI interfaces](api/AiInterfaces.md))
- `ui.AgentStatus(UiText text, AgentStatusOpts o = default)` → `void` — Agent status pill: what the agent is doing right now and for how long.  ([AI interfaces](api/AiInterfaces.md))
- `ui.ChatComposer(UiText id, ref string buf, int cap, ref int removed, ref int model, ComposerOpts o = default)` → `ComposerEvents`  ([AI interfaces](api/AiInterfaces.md))
- `ui.Citation(int number, in Source source)` → `bool`  ([AI interfaces](api/AiInterfaces.md))
- `ui.ContextMeter(UiText id, float used, float limit, ContextOpts o = default)` → `void` — Context meter: a small ring of how full the context is; hover for a breakdown. It turns amber past 80% and red past 95%.  ([AI interfaces](api/AiInterfaces.md))
- `ui.ModelPicker(UiText id, ReadOnlySpan<Model> models, ref int selected, ModelPickerOpts o = default)` → `bool` — Model picker: the current model on a button; a list with details opens.  ([AI interfaces](api/AiInterfaces.md))
- `ui.PromptSuggestions(UiText id, ReadOnlySpan<PromptSuggestion> items, PromptSuggestionsOpts o = default)` → `int` — Prompt suggestions: cards to start a conversation with.  ([AI interfaces](api/AiInterfaces.md))
- `ui.Reasoning(UiText id, ReasoningOpts o = default)` → `OpenScope` — Reasoning: a model's thinking. While thinking, the header shimmers and counts the seconds; afterwards it reads "Thought for 12s" and the body folds away. Click the header to open or close it. Put text inside.  ([AI interfaces](api/AiInterfaces.md))
- `ui.ResponseActions(UiText id, ref int vote, ResponseActionsOpts o = default)` → `ResponseEvents`  ([AI interfaces](api/AiInterfaces.md))
- `ui.SourceList(UiText id, ReadOnlySpan<Source> sources)` → `int`  ([AI interfaces](api/AiInterfaces.md))
- `ui.ToolCall(UiText id, UiText name, ToolCallOpts o = default)` → `void`  ([AI interfaces](api/AiInterfaces.md))
- `ui.VoiceOrb(UiText id, VoiceState state, float level, VoiceOrbOpts o = default)` → `bool`  ([AI interfaces](api/AiInterfaces.md))
- `ui.ApiExplorer(UiText id, ReadOnlySpan<ApiEndpoint> endpoints, ref int selected, ApiExplorerOpts o = default)` → `ApiExplorerResult`  ([API explorer](api/ApiExplorer.md))
- `ui.DocTabs(UiText id, ReadOnlySpan<DocTab> tabs, ref int selected, DocTabsOpts o = default)` → `DocTabsResult` — Document tabs: editor style tabs. Clicking selects (*selected is updated), the x or a middle click asks to close, dragging reorders, and the strip scrolls sideways when the tabs do not fit. A dirty tab shows a dot that turns into the close button under the pointer. The selected tab is filled with the surface color so it joins the content below; the strip itself has no fill, like the other bars. Tabs keep their state by title, so give two tabs with the same name a key: "main.c##src". The component never removes or moves your tabs itself: it reports a close or a move in the result and you apply it (selection already follows a move). With keyboard focus on the strip, Left and Right select, Home and End jump, Shift+Left/Right move the tab and Delete closes it. With `shortcuts` set it also answers Ctrl+Tab, Ctrl+Shift+Tab, Ctrl+PageUp/Down and Ctrl+W (Cmd+W on macOS) from anywhere in the window.  ([App chrome: menu bar, toolbar, status bar, document tabs](api/AppChrome.md))
- `ui.MenuBar(UiText id, MenuBarOpts o = default)` → `LayoutScope` — Menu bar: File / Edit / View along the top of a window. Each menu holds the usual menu items (cui_menu_item, cui_menu_separator, cui_menu_label). Once a menu is open, hovering another one switches to it. Alt (on its own) or F10 focuses the bar; arrows move between menus and items, Enter chooses, Esc steps back. Alt + a menu's mnemonic letter opens it (the first letter of its label unless `mnemonic` says otherwise).  ([App chrome: menu bar, toolbar, status bar, document tabs](api/AppChrome.md))
- `ui.MenuBarMenu(UiText label, MenuBarMenuOpts o = default)` → `OpenScope` — One menu of the bar. Returns true while its items should be built; call cui_menu_bar_menu_end only then.  ([App chrome: menu bar, toolbar, status bar, document tabs](api/AppChrome.md))
- `ui.StatusBar(UiText id, StatusBarOpts o = default)` → `LayoutScope` — Status bar: a thin bar along the bottom of a window, with a hairline on top and no fill of its own (put it in a box with the background you want). Items go left to right; cui_status_bar_spacer sends the rest to the right edge.  ([App chrome: menu bar, toolbar, status bar, document tabs](api/AppChrome.md))
- `ui.StatusBarItem(UiText label, StatusItemOpts o = default)` → `bool` — A small clickable item ("Ln 12, Col 4", "UTF-8"). Returns true when clicked.  ([App chrome: menu bar, toolbar, status bar, document tabs](api/AppChrome.md))
- `ui.StatusBarProgress(float value, StatusProgressOpts o = default)` → `void` — A small progress bar with an optional label. value is 0..1.  ([App chrome: menu bar, toolbar, status bar, document tabs](api/AppChrome.md))
- `ui.StatusBarSpacer()` → `void`  ([App chrome: menu bar, toolbar, status bar, document tabs](api/AppChrome.md))
- `ui.StatusBarText(UiText text, StatusItemOpts o = default)` → `void` — A message; `tone` colors its icon.  ([App chrome: menu bar, toolbar, status bar, document tabs](api/AppChrome.md))
- `ui.Toolbar(UiText id, ToolbarOpts o = default)` → `LayoutScope` — Toolbar: a row of compact icon buttons, toggles, separators and small text buttons. Icon only buttons show their tooltip as their name. Items that do not fit collapse, from the end, into a "more" menu; an item chosen there returns true on the next frame.  ([App chrome: menu bar, toolbar, status bar, document tabs](api/AppChrome.md))
- `ui.ToolbarButton(UiText icon, ref bool toggle, ToolOpts o = default)` → `bool`  ([App chrome: menu bar, toolbar, status bar, document tabs](api/AppChrome.md))
- `ui.ToolbarSeparator()` → `void`  ([App chrome: menu bar, toolbar, status bar, document tabs](api/AppChrome.md))
- `ui.ToolbarSpacer()` → `void` — pushes the following items to the right  ([App chrome: menu bar, toolbar, status bar, document tabs](api/AppChrome.md))
- `ui.Blame(UiText id, ReadOnlySpan<string> lines, ReadOnlySpan<int> lineCommit, ReadOnlySpan<BlameCommit> commits, BlameOpts o = default)` → `BlameResult` — Source with who last changed each line: lines from one commit share one gutter entry with its author, age and hash, and a bar at the edge shades newer changes stronger. Hover a gutter entry for the commit's summary and to mark its lines; click it to get the commit. Only the lines in view are built. On a phone the gutter keeps only the shade and initials.  ([Blame](api/Blame.md))
- `ui.Button(UiText label, ButtonOpts o = default)` → `bool`  ([Buttons](api/Buttons.md))
- `ui.IconButton(UiText icon, ButtonOpts o = default)` → `bool` — Square/round button with only an icon. Give it a tooltip so it has a name.  ([Buttons](api/Buttons.md))
- `ui.Segmented(UiText id, ReadOnlySpan<string> items, ref int index, SegmentedOpts o = default)` → `bool` — Segmented control: a row of options with a gliding highlight.  ([Buttons](api/Buttons.md))
- `ui.AvatarUpload(UiText id, UiText name, ref ulong image, float size)` → `int` — Avatar upload: a round avatar that takes a dropped image, with a camera badge on hover. Returns 1 when *image changed, -1 when clicked (browse), 0 otherwise. A dropped image is loaded with cui_image_load.  ([Capture](api/Capture.md))
- `ui.Dropzone(UiText id, DropzoneOpts o = default)` → `int` — Dropzone: drop files from the OS, or click to browse. Returns the number of files dropped on it this frame (read them with cui_dropped_file), -1 when clicked (open a file dialog), 0 otherwise. accept filters by extension, e.g. "png;jpg;pdf".  ([Capture](api/Capture.md))
- `ui.SignatureClear(UiText id)` → `void`  ([Capture](api/Capture.md))
- `ui.SignaturePad(UiText id, SignatureOpts o = default)` → `bool` — Signature pad: draw with the mouse or a pen. The strokes are kept for you; read them with cui_signature_points (stroke_ends[i] is one past the last point of stroke i).  ([Capture](api/Capture.md))
- `ui.CodeBlock(UiText id, UiText code, CodeOpts o = default)` → `void` — Code block with syntax highlighting (lang: "c", "cpp", "js", "ts", "python", "rust", "go", "json", "shell", or "text" for none), line numbers, a title bar and a copy button. Long lines scroll sideways.  ([Code](api/Code.md))
- `ui.JsonView(UiText id, UiText json, JsonOpts o = default)` → `bool` — JSON viewer: a collapsible tree with typed colors and item counts. Returns false when the text is not valid JSON (and shows the error).  ([Code](api/Code.md))
- `ui.CodeEditor(UiText id, ref string buf, int cap, CodeEditorOpts o = default)` → `CodeEditorResult`  ([Code editor](api/CodeEditor.md))
- `ui.CodeEditorFind(UiText id, UiText query)` → `void` — Opens the find bar with query and selects the next match (NULL closes).  ([Code editor](api/CodeEditor.md))
- `ui.CodeEditorGoto(UiText id, int line, int column)` → `void` — On the editor's next frame: put the caret at a line and column (1 based), focus the editor and scroll there. Call from the same id scope.  ([Code editor](api/CodeEditor.md))
- `ui.CodeEditorSelect(UiText id, int anchor, int cursor)` → `void` — On the next frame: select bytes anchor..cursor, focus and scroll there.  ([Code editor](api/CodeEditor.md))
- `ui.CommandPalette(ref bool open, ReadOnlySpan<Command> commands)` → `int` — Spotlight style command palette. Returns the index of the chosen command, or -1. Open it with a shortcut: if (cui_shortcut(ui, CUI_MOD_PRIMARY, CUI_KEY_K)) open = true;  ([Command palette (block)](api/CommandPaletteBlock.md))
- `ui.CommitGraph(UiText id, ReadOnlySpan<Commit> commits, ref int selected, CommitGraphOpts o = default)` → `CommitGraphResult` — Version history: the branch lanes drawn beside each commit, newest first, with its message, branch and tag names, author, date and short hash. Each commit names its parents by row (parents come later in the array), so merges and branches draw as lines between lanes. Only the rows in view are built. Up and Down move the selection; Enter or a double-click activates.  ([Commit graph](api/CommitGraph.md))
- `ui.ChatDivider(UiText label)` → `void` — "Today"  ([Conversation](api/Conversation.md))
- `ui.ChatMessage(UiText text, ref MarkdownResult markdownResult, ChatOpts o = default)` → `void` — Chat message bubble. Consecutive messages from one person set grouped so they stack tightly and show the avatar once.  ([Conversation](api/Conversation.md))
- `ui.Comment(UiText id, UiText author, UiText text, ref int likes, ref bool liked, CommentOpts o = default)` → `CommentEvents`  ([Conversation](api/Conversation.md))
- `ui.Presence(UiText id, ReadOnlySpan<PresenceUser> users, int maxVisible, float size)` → `void` — Presence: who is here now. Overlapping avatars with a colored ring each, that spread out on hover and name themselves.  ([Conversation](api/Conversation.md))
- `ui.TypingIndicator(UiText name)` → `void` — bouncing dots  ([Conversation](api/Conversation.md))
- `ui.Coverage(UiText id, ReadOnlySpan<CoverageFile> files, CoverageOpts o = default)` → `CoverageResult` — Test coverage by folder and file: the files' paths make the tree, each folder sums up what it holds, and folders fold. Line coverage shows as a bar colored by thresholds, with branches and functions beside it. Click a column's title to sort. Enter or a double-click activates a file. Narrow panels show lines only.  ([Coverage](api/Coverage.md))
- `ui.CurveEditor(UiText id, Span<CurveKey> keys, ref int count, ref int selected, CurveOpts o = default)` → `CurveResult`  ([Curve and gradient editors](api/CurveAndGradientEditors.md))
- `ui.GradientEditor(UiText id, Span<GradientStop> stops, ref int count, ref int selected, GradientOpts o = default)` → `GradientResult`  ([Curve and gradient editors](api/CurveAndGradientEditors.md))
- `ui.Accordion(UiText title, ref bool open)` → `OpenScope` — Accordion / disclosure. Content animates its height.  ([Data display](api/DataDisplay.md))
- `ui.Cropper(UiText id, ulong tex, int imageW, int imageH, ref RectF crop, CropperOpts o = default)` → `bool` — Returns true when the crop changed.  ([Data display](api/DataDisplay.md))
- `ui.Gauge(UiText label, float value, float size = 130)` → `void`  ([Data display](api/DataDisplay.md))
- `ui.Image(ulong tex, ImageOpts o = default)` → `void`  ([Data display](api/DataDisplay.md))
- `ui.ImageViewer(UiText id, ulong tex, int imageW, int imageH, ref ImageView view, ImageViewerOpts o = default)` → `bool` — Returns true when the view changed.  ([Data display](api/DataDisplay.md))
- `ui.ListItem(UiText title, ListItemOpts o = default)` → `bool` — List item: a selectable row with optional icon, subtitle and trailing text.  ([Data display](api/DataDisplay.md))
- `ui.Sparkline(ReadOnlySpan<float> values, Size width, float height, Color color)` → `void`  ([Data display](api/DataDisplay.md))
- `ui.Table(UiText id, ReadOnlySpan<TableColumn> columns, ref TableSort sort, TableOpts o = default)` → `OpenScope`  ([Data display](api/DataDisplay.md))
- `ui.TableCell()` → `void` — Next cell; put any components inside, or use cui_table_cell_text.  ([Data display](api/DataDisplay.md))
- `ui.TableCellText(UiText text)` → `void` — Part of cui_table_cell — Next cell; put any components inside, or use cui_table_cell_text.  ([Data display](api/DataDisplay.md))
- `ui.TableRow(bool selected)` → `bool` — Begin a row. Returns true when the row is clicked.  ([Data display](api/DataDisplay.md))
- `ui.Tree(UiText label, ref bool open, TreeOpts o = default)` → `OpenScope`  ([Data display](api/DataDisplay.md))
- `ui.TreeClicked()` → `bool` — the node created by the last cui_tree_begin was clicked  ([Data display](api/DataDisplay.md))
- `ui.VirtualList(UiText id, int count, float rowHeight, Size height, out int first, out int last)` → `LayoutScope` — Virtual list: only the visible rows are built, so lists with a million rows stay fast. Fills first/last with the visible range.  ([Data display](api/DataDisplay.md))
- `ui.DataGridCell()` → `void` — next cell; put components inside  ([Data grid](api/DataGrid.md))
- `ui.DataGridCellEdit(ref string buf, int cap)` → `bool` — Editable text cell: double click (or Enter on the cursor row) to edit, Enter or clicking away commits, Esc reverts. True when committed.  ([Data grid](api/DataGrid.md))
- `ui.DataGridCellText(UiText text)` → `void`  ([Data grid](api/DataGrid.md))
- `ui.DataGridEdit(ref string buf, int cap)` → `bool` — The same editable text, inside the current cell (after an avatar, say).  ([Data grid](api/DataGrid.md))
- `ui.DataGridRow(int row)` → `bool` — true when the row was clicked  ([Data grid](api/DataGrid.md))
- `ui.TreeCell(UiText label, int depth, bool hasChildren, ref bool open, UiText icon)` → `bool` — Tree cell: indentation, a disclosure chevron and a label, for tree tables (use it in a table or grid cell). Returns true when *open toggled.  ([Data grid](api/DataGrid.md))
- `ui.GraphView(UiText id, ReadOnlySpan<GraphNode> nodes, ReadOnlySpan<GraphEdge> edges, ref int selected, GraphOpts o = default)` → `GraphResult` — Nodes and directed edges laid out in layers (each edge points to a later layer, cycles are broken), for build targets, packages, services or call graphs. The layout is computed when the graph changes. Wheel zooms, drag pans, click selects; hovering a node lights up what it depends on and what depends on it. F fits the graph.  ([Dependency graph](api/DependencyGraph.md))
- `ui.Alert(UiText title, AlertOpts o = default)` → `bool` — Inline alert. Returns false once dismissed (when dismissible).  ([Dialogs, sheets, toasts, alerts](api/DialogsSheetsToastsAlerts.md))
- `ui.Dialog(UiText title, ref bool open, DialogOpts o = default)` → `OpenScope` — Modal dialog. Shown while *open is true; closing sets it to false.  ([Dialogs, sheets, toasts, alerts](api/DialogsSheetsToastsAlerts.md))
- `ui.DialogFooter()` → `LayoutScope` — A right-aligned row for dialog actions.  ([Dialogs, sheets, toasts, alerts](api/DialogsSheetsToastsAlerts.md))
- `ui.Sheet(UiText title, ref bool open, SheetOpts o = default)` → `OpenScope`  ([Dialogs, sheets, toasts, alerts](api/DialogsSheetsToastsAlerts.md))
- `ui.Toast(UiText title, ToastOpts o = default)` → `int` — Queue a toast. Returns a handle; cui_toast_action_clicked(handle) tells whether its action button was pressed.  ([Dialogs, sheets, toasts, alerts](api/DialogsSheetsToastsAlerts.md))
- `ui.ToastActionClicked(int handle)` → `bool`  ([Dialogs, sheets, toasts, alerts](api/DialogsSheetsToastsAlerts.md))
- `ui.ToastDismiss(int handle)` → `void`  ([Dialogs, sheets, toasts, alerts](api/DialogsSheetsToastsAlerts.md))
- `ui.DiffView(UiText id, UiText oldText, UiText newText, ref int current, DiffOpts o = default)` → `DiffResult`  ([Diff viewer](api/DiffViewer.md))
- `ui.ConfirmPopover(UiText id, ConfirmPopoverOpts o = default)` → `bool` — Confirm popover: a small question anchored to the previous component. Open it with cui_popover_open(ui, id). Returns true when confirmed.  ([Disclosure](api/Disclosure.md))
- `ui.ExpandableCard(UiText title, ref bool open, ExpandableCardOpts o = default)` → `OpenScope` — Expandable card: a card whose header opens a body with a height spring.  ([Disclosure](api/Disclosure.md))
- `ui.ExpandableText(UiText id, UiText text, ExpandableTextOpts o = default)` → `bool` — Text clamped to a few lines with a fade and Show more / Show less.  ([Disclosure](api/Disclosure.md))
- `ui.HoverCard(UiText id, HoverCardOpts o = default)` → `OpenScope` — Hover card: rich content that appears when the pointer rests on the previous component, and stays while the pointer is over either.  ([Disclosure](api/Disclosure.md))
- `ui.Toc(UiText scrollId, ReadOnlySpan<TocItem> items)` → `int` — Table of contents for a scroll area: highlights the section in view on a progress rail, and scrolls to a section when clicked. - `ui.DockSave(UiText id, ref string buf, int cap)` → `ulong` — Saved layout: one line, e.g. dock1 h0.22([*Scene tree,Assets],v0.7([*Viewport],[*Log,-Console])) h splits side by side and v stacks, the number is the first child's share, [..] is a leaf's tabs in order, * the selected tab, - a closed panel; a backslash escapes , [ ] ( ) and itself in names. cui_dock_save returns the full length (as snprintf does) and writes what fits, or 0 when there is no layout. cui_dock_load replaces the layout (and sets each panel's *open from it on its next frame); names it does not know yet are kept for when they appear. Malformed text returns false and changes nothing.  ([Docking](api/Docking.md))

- `ui.EmojiFontLoadFile(UiText path)` → `bool` — Color emoji come from an emoji font: the system's (cui_emoji_font_load_system, which the picker calls by itself when nothing is loaded) or one the app ships. Bitmap color fonts (sbix as on macOS, CBDT as on Linux and Android) and layered ones (COLR version 0, as on Windows) are read, as is a plain outline font for one-color emoji. Sequences with skin tones, joined people and flags are looked up through the font's ligatures. Big fonts are read from the file as needed rather than loaded whole. Drawn emoji are kept in one texture and reused.  ([Emoji](api/Emoji.md))

- `ui.NavItem(UiText label, NavOpts o = default)` → `bool` — Sidebar navigation item with a gliding selection highlight shared by all items in the same group.  ([Navigation](api/Navigation.md))
- `ui.NavSection(UiText title)` → `void`  ([Navigation](api/Navigation.md))
- `ui.Pagination(UiText id, ref int page, int pageCount)` → `bool` — page is 0 based  ([Navigation](api/Navigation.md))
- `ui.Stepper(ReadOnlySpan<string> steps, int current)` → `void`  ([Navigation](api/Navigation.md))
- `ui.Tabs(UiText id, ReadOnlySpan<string> items, ref int index, TabsOpts o = default)` → `bool`  ([Navigation](api/Navigation.md))
- `ui.Waterfall(UiText id, ReadOnlySpan<NetRequest> requests, ref int selected, WaterfallOpts o = default)` → `WaterfallResult` — HTTP requests as a table with a timing bar each: queued, DNS, connect, TLS, waiting for the first byte and downloading, on one time scale with the page's DOMContentLoaded and load lines. Hover a bar for the breakdown. Narrow panels drop the type and size columns. Only the rows in view are built. Up and Down move the selection.  ([Network waterfall](api/NetworkWaterfall.md))
- `ui.Node(int nodeId, ref float x, ref float y, UiText title, NodeOpts o = default)` → `OpenScope` — A node at canvas position (*x, *y), updated while it is dragged. Returns true while the node is selected.  ([Node editor](api/NodeEditor.md))
- `ui.NodeContent()` → `LayoutScope` — A row for ordinary components. They are laid out at 100% and scaled with the view, so their text is sharpest at 100% zoom and below.  ([Node editor](api/NodeEditor.md))
- `ui.NodeDeleted(ref int nodeId)` → `bool`  ([Node editor](api/NodeEditor.md))
- `ui.NodeEditor(UiText id, ref NodeView view, NodeEditorOpts o = default)` → `OpenScope` — Node editor: nodes with input and output pins on a canvas that pans and zooms, joined by curved links. You own the nodes, pins and links; the editor moves the node positions you pass and reports what the user did:  ([Node editor](api/NodeEditor.md))
- `ui.NodeInput(int pinId, UiText label, PinOpts o = default)` → `bool` — A row with a pin on the left (input) or right (output). type picks the pin color from the series palette and limits links to pins of the same type (0 connects to anything). Returns true when the pin has a link.  ([Node editor](api/NodeEditor.md))
- `ui.NodeLink(int linkId, int fromPin, int toPin)` → `bool` — A link from an output pin to an input pin. Returns true while it is selected.  ([Node editor](api/NodeEditor.md))
- `ui.NodeLinkCreated(ref int fromPin, ref int toPin)` → `bool` — What the user did this frame, one event per call; call them after cui_node_editor_begin (and up to the end of the frame).  ([Node editor](api/NodeEditor.md))
- `ui.NodeLinkRemoved(ref int linkId)` → `bool` — Part of cui_node_link — A link from an output pin to an input pin. Returns true while it is selected.  ([Node editor](api/NodeEditor.md))
- `ui.NodeOutput(int pinId, UiText label, PinOpts o = default)` → `bool` — A row with a pin on the left (input) or right (output). type picks the pin color from the series palette and limits links to pins of the same type (0 connects to anything). Returns true when the pin has a link.  ([Node editor](api/NodeEditor.md))
- `ui.DateRangePicker(UiText id, ref DateRange range, DateRangeOpts o = default)` → `bool`  ([Pickers](api/Pickers.md))
- `ui.Fader(UiText id, ref float value, float min, float max, FaderOpts o = default)` → `bool`  ([Pickers](api/Pickers.md))
- `ui.HistogramSlider(UiText label, ReadOnlySpan<float> bins, ref float lo, ref float hi, float min, float max, HistogramOpts o = default)` → `bool` — Range slider over a histogram of the data it filters.  ([Pickers](api/Pickers.md))
- `ui.Knob(UiText id, ref float value, float min, float max, KnobOpts o = default)` → `bool` — Knob, fader and level meter: the controls of audio, synth and mixer panels.  ([Pickers](api/Pickers.md))
- `ui.LevelMeter(UiText id, ReadOnlySpan<float> levels, LevelMeterOpts o = default)` → `bool` — Returns true when the clip light was clicked to clear it.  ([Pickers](api/Pickers.md))
- `ui.RangeCalendar(UiText id, ref DateRange range, int months)` → `bool` — One or two months side by side; click a start and an end.  ([Pickers](api/Pickers.md))
- `ui.RulerSlider(UiText label, ref float value, float min, float max, RulerOpts o = default)` → `bool` — Ruler slider: a tape measure that slides under a fixed marker, with momentum and snapping to step.  ([Pickers](api/Pickers.md))
- `ui.TimeDial(UiText id, ref int hour, ref int minute, float size)` → `bool` — Time dial: a clock face. Drag the hand to set hours, then minutes.  ([Pickers](api/Pickers.md))
- `ui.TimePicker(UiText id, ref int hour, ref int minute, TimeOpts o = default)` → `bool` — Time picker: a field that opens hour and minute columns. hour is 0..23.  ([Pickers](api/Pickers.md))
- `ui.WheelPicker(UiText id, ReadOnlySpan<string> items, ref int index, WheelOpts o = default)` → `bool` — Wheel picker: a drum of options that you drag, scroll or arrow through. Several side by side make a date or time reel. join_left / join_right square off the selection band so wheels placed side by side share one continuous band.  ([Pickers](api/Pickers.md))
- `ui.Pipeline(UiText id, ReadOnlySpan<string> stages, ReadOnlySpan<PipelineJob> jobs, ref int selected, PipelineOpts o = default)` → `PipelineResult`  ([Pipeline](api/Pipeline.md))
- `ui.Gantt(UiText id, Span<GanttTask> tasks, Date origin, int days, GanttOpts o = default)` → `int` — Gantt chart: a task list beside a timeline of bars. Drag a bar to move it, its ends to resize it. Dependencies are drawn as elbow arrows. Returns the index of a clicked task, or -1.  ([Planning](api/Planning.md))
- `ui.Kanban(UiText id)` → `bool`  ([Planning](api/Planning.md))
- `ui.KanbanCard(int cardId)` → `LayoutScope` — true when clicked  ([Planning](api/Planning.md))
- `ui.KanbanColumn(UiText title, int cardCount, KanbanColumnOpts o = default)` → `LayoutScope` — true: "+" clicked  ([Planning](api/Planning.md))
- `ui.MonthCalendar(UiText id, ref Date month, ReadOnlySpan<MonthEvent> events, ref Date selected, MonthOpts o = default)` → `MonthResult` — Month calendar: a month grid with events. All-day and multi-day events are bars across the days they cover; timed events are a dot, a time and a title. A day with more than fits says "+N more" and opens a list of them. On a narrow screen the cells show colored dots and the selected day's events are listed under the grid.  ([Planning](api/Planning.md))
- `ui.WeekCalendar(UiText id, Date weekStart, Span<CalendarEvent> events, WeekOpts o = default)` → `int` — Week calendar: seven day columns on an hour grid. Drag an event to move it (15 minute steps), drag its bottom edge to resize it. Returns the index of a clicked event, or -1.  ([Planning](api/Planning.md))
- `ui.Problems(UiText id, ReadOnlySpan<ProblemItem> diags, ProblemsOpts o = default)` → `ProblemsResult`  ([Problems panel](api/ProblemsPanel.md))
- `ui.QueryBuilder(UiText id, ReadOnlySpan<QueryField> fields, Span<QueryNode> nodes, ref int count, QueryOpts o = default)` → `bool`  ([Query builder](api/QueryBuilder.md))
- `ui.RegexTester(UiText id, ref string pattern, int patternCap, ref string text, int textCap, ref RegexFlags flags, RegexTesterOpts o = default)` → `RegexTesterResult` — A pattern field with flags over a test text: every match is highlighted in the text and its groups in their own colors, and the list below shows each match with its groups. Errors show under the pattern. Both buffers are yours and edited in place.  ([Regular expressions and the regex tester](api/RegularExpressionsAndTheRegexTester.md))
- `ui.CronDescribe(UiText cron)` → `string?` — "Every weekday at 09:30", in frame memory; NULL when invalid.  ([Schedule picker](api/SchedulePicker.md))
- `ui.SchedulePicker(UiText id, ref string cron, int cap = 128, ScheduleOpts o = default)` → `ScheduleResult` — A cron schedule edited the friendly way: every N minutes, hourly at a minute, daily at a time, weekly on chosen days, monthly on a day, or a custom expression. It reads and writes `cron` (five fields: minute hour day month weekday) and shows what it means and when it runs next. Weekday and month names come from cui_set_strings.  ([Schedule picker](api/SchedulePicker.md))
- `ui.Calendar(UiText id, ref Date value)` → `bool`  ([Select, combobox, date picker](api/SelectComboboxDatePicker.md))
- `ui.ColorPicker(UiText id, ref Color value)` → `bool`  ([Select, combobox, date picker](api/SelectComboboxDatePicker.md))
- `ui.DatePicker(UiText id, ref Date value, DateOpts o = default)` → `bool`  ([Select, combobox, date picker](api/SelectComboboxDatePicker.md))
- `ui.Select(UiText id, ReadOnlySpan<string> items, ref int index, SelectOpts o = default)` → `bool`  ([Select, combobox, date picker](api/SelectComboboxDatePicker.md))
- `ui.Checkbox(UiText label, ref bool value, CheckOpts o = default)` → `bool`  ([Selection controls](api/SelectionControls.md))
- `ui.Chip(UiText label, ref bool selected, ChipOpts o = default)` → `bool`  ([Selection controls](api/SelectionControls.md))
- `ui.Radio(UiText label, ref int value, int option, CheckOpts o = default)` → `bool`  ([Selection controls](api/SelectionControls.md))
- `ui.RadioGroup(UiText id, ReadOnlySpan<string> items, ref int index)` → `bool`  ([Selection controls](api/SelectionControls.md))
- `ui.RangeSlider(UiText label, ref float lo, ref float hi, float min, float max)` → `bool`  ([Selection controls](api/SelectionControls.md))
- `ui.Rating(UiText id, ref int value, int max = 5)` → `bool`  ([Selection controls](api/SelectionControls.md))
- `ui.Slider(UiText label, ref float value, float min, float max, SliderOpts o = default)` → `bool` — Elastic slider: the track stretches like rubber when dragged past its ends.  ([Selection controls](api/SelectionControls.md))
- `ui.Switch(UiText label, ref bool value, CheckOpts o = default)` → `bool`  ([Selection controls](api/SelectionControls.md))
- `ui.StackTrace(UiText id, ReadOnlySpan<StackFrame> frames, StackTraceOpts o = default)` → `StackTraceResult` — An exception and its call stack: the error's type and message, then each frame's function and position. Runs of library frames fold into one row. A frame with source opens to show the lines around it, the failing line marked; the first frame of your own code starts open. A button copies the whole trace as text.  ([Stack trace](api/StackTrace.md))
- `ui.TestExplorer(UiText id, ReadOnlySpan<TestItem> items, TestExplorerOpts o = default)` → `TestExplorerResult` — Test results as a tree: suites fold, each test shows its status and time, and a failure shows its message under it. A suite's status sums up its tests. The toolbar runs everything, counts results and filters by status and by name. Hover a row for its run button. Only the rows in view are built. Up and Down move, Left and Right fold, Enter activates. Items are in tree order with their depth; the statuses are the pipeline's.  ([Test explorer](api/TestExplorer.md))
- `ui.Code(UiText text)` → `void` — inline code  ([Text](api/Text.md))
- `ui.Heading(UiText text, int level = 2)` → `void` — 1..4  ([Text](api/Text.md))
- `ui.Kbd(UiText keys)` → `void` — keyboard keycap, e.g. "Ctrl K"  ([Text](api/Text.md))
- `ui.Label(UiText text)` → `void` — medium weight  ([Text](api/Text.md))
- `ui.Link(UiText text)` → `bool`  ([Text](api/Text.md))
- `ui.Muted(UiText text)` → `void` — small, muted  ([Text](api/Text.md))
- `ui.Secondary(UiText text)` → `void` — secondary color  ([Text](api/Text.md))
- `ui.Text(UiText text, TextOpts o = default)` → `void`  ([Text](api/Text.md))
- `ui.TimeHistogram(UiText id, double start, double bucketSeconds, int buckets, ReadOnlySpan<HistogramSeries> series, ref double selStart, ref double selEnd, TimeHistogramOpts o = default)` → `TimeHistogramResult` — Event counts over time, stacked by series (log levels, status classes), as above a log search. Drag across it to select a time range, click to clear. Hover a bar for its time and counts. Times are Unix seconds.  ([Time histogram](api/TimeHistogram.md))
- `ui.TraceView(UiText id, ReadOnlySpan<TraceTrack> tracks, ReadOnlySpan<TraceSpan> spans, ref TraceViewState view, ref int selected, TraceOpts o = default)` → `TraceResult` — A tracing timeline: one lane per thread, process or service, each with its nested spans, on one time ruler, with markers (frames, GC pauses, deploys) drawn across every lane. Wheel zooms around the pointer, Shift+wheel or a drag pans, click selects a span, Shift+drag measures a time range. A lane's name folds it. Keys: Left and Right step through the selected span's lane, + and - zoom, F fits, Esc clears. Spans must be sorted by track, depth and start (cui_trace_sort), with no overlap within a depth of a track. Like the flame graph, only what is in view is visited.  ([Trace viewer](api/TraceViewer.md))
- `ui.FileBrowser(UiText id, ref string path, int pathCap = 1024, FileBrowserOpts o = default)` → `FileBrowserResult` — path: the folder shown, yours; the browser writes it as you move around.  ([Tree table and path bar](api/TreeTableAndPathBar.md))
- `ui.FilePicker(UiText id, ref bool open, ref string @out, int outCap = 1024, FilePickerOpts o = default)` → `bool` — True once, with the chosen path in out, when the dialog is confirmed; *open turns false then, or on Cancel and Esc.  ([Tree table and path bar](api/TreeTableAndPathBar.md))
- `ui.PathBar(UiText id, ReadOnlySpan<string> segments, PathBarOpts o = default)` → `PathBarResult` — Path bar: a breadcrumb for file and scene paths. Segments are clickable, the last one is the current place. Middle segments that do not fit collapse into a "..." menu. With .menus, the chevron after segment k opens a menu you fill with the children of segment k (cui_path_bar_menu_begin). Click the empty part (or the current segment), or press Ctrl+L, to type a path: Enter submits it, Esc or clicking away cancels.  ([Tree table and path bar](api/TreeTableAndPathBar.md))
- `ui.PathBarMenu(UiText id, ref int segment)` → `OpenScope` — True while the menu of separator *segment is showing: build menu items for the children of that segment, then call cui_path_bar_menu_end.  ([Tree table and path bar](api/TreeTableAndPathBar.md))
- `ui.TreeTableDepth()` → `int` — depth of the current row, 0 at the top  ([Tree table and path bar](api/TreeTableAndPathBar.md))
- `ui.TreeTableName(UiText label, UiText icon)` → `void` — The first cell: indentation, guides, the chevron, an icon and the name (cut short with a tooltip of the whole name when it does not fit).  ([Tree table and path bar](api/TreeTableAndPathBar.md))
- `ui.TreeTableRow()` → `int` — The next row in view: returns its node, or -1 when done. Then build its cells: cui_tree_table_name first, then cui_data_grid_cell(_text).  ([Tree table and path bar](api/TreeTableAndPathBar.md))
- `ui.Uptime(UiText id, ReadOnlySpan<UptimeService> services, UptimeOpts o = default)` → `UptimeResult` — A status page: each service with its current state, its uptime over the period, and one bar per day colored by availability (gray without data). Hover a bar for its day and uptime. On a narrow panel only the most recent days that fit are shown.  ([Uptime bars](api/UptimeBars.md))

## Members with no C function behind them

Hand-written, because the wrapper needs state a C call cannot carry; they are part of the same `ui`.

- `ui.AccentName(...)` — hand-written in `Ui/Ui.Frame.cs`
- `ui.AddFontFallback(...)` — hand-written in `Ui/Ui.Fonts.cs`
- `ui.Animate(...)` — hand-written in `Ui/Ui.Draw.cs`
- `ui.AnimateSpring(...)` — hand-written in `Ui/Ui.Draw.cs`
- `ui.Canvas(...)` — hand-written in `Ui/Ui.Draw.cs`
- `ui.Clip(...)` — hand-written in `Ui/Ui.Draw.cs`
- `ui.ColorOf(...)` — hand-written in `Ui/Ui.Frame.cs`
- `ui.CreateImage(...)` — hand-written in `Ui/Ui.Images.cs`
- `ui.DataGrid(...)` — hand-written in `Ui/Ui.DataGrid.cs`
- `ui.DateToday(...)` — hand-written in `Ui/Ui.Overlays.cs`
- `ui.DestroyImage(...)` — hand-written in `Ui/Ui.Images.cs`
- `ui.DiffRows(...)` — hand-written in `Ui/Ui.Diff.cs`
- `ui.Disabled(...)` — hand-written in `Ui/Ui.Frame.cs`
- `ui.Dispose(...)` — hand-written in `Ui/Ui.DataGrid.cs`
- `ui.DotChart(...)` — hand-written in `Ui/Ui.Instruments.cs`

Every path above is in this folder, which is the whole of what an app needs: it is the same
folder in the repository and in the package, and nothing in it points outside itself.
